gotchas: FromFile returns IContentBase (interface), NOT FileToken
Must set up Repository on BOTH mockJobOutput AND mockFromFile
FromFile.Lines must return non-null List<ContentLine> — ContentRange constructors call BuildLines
Lines must be non-null for ContentRange constructors
RepoFileName is relative path, FullFileName is absolute
RepoPath should be absolute path for path-joining operations
References is a HashSet<string>, not List<string>
Id format is typically lowercase-with-dashes
Use Mock<ILogger>() not Mock<ILogger<T>>() unless constructor specifically requires generic version
Moq.ILogger extension methods may need special verification patterns
LintIndex has multiple constructor overloads — check which one you need
FromAudit chain requires a real AuditEntry, not mock
ArtifactType uses ArtifactEnum (Header/Table/CodeFence, NOT H1/H2)
CodeLines can be null in some contexts — set up returns explicitly
FileName is relative, not absolute
TestResultValue Untested maps to implicit boolean true
Get/Set pattern varies by concrete implementation
Combine method has specific default parameter behavior — null vs empty list
Names dictionary keyed by IWriteTo enum — constructor only sets WorkItem key
BasePath is the docset root, LocalizedRepoPath is the repo root — they differ
